prose: Joanna Stern interviews Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella about the new Surface Laptop Ultra - powered by an Nvidia RTX Spark chip - and Microsoft's plan to make Windows a safer operating system for running AI agents. The framing: with a billion-plus Windows machines, the OS is both a target for rogue agents and the place those agents will do their work.
The conversation also ranges over AI risk more broadly - 'whether AI will kill us' - and, inevitably, Clippy.
highlights: Nadella interview tied to the Nvidia RTX Spark-powered Surface Laptop Ultra
Microsoft plans to make Windows safer for running AI agents
Windows' billion-device footprint makes it both target and host for rogue agents
Also covers AI risk and Clippy
Published in Joanna Stern's The New Things
